python3 << 'EOF'
import re

# Simpler validation logic
def validate_part(part):
    if not part:
        return True, "empty"
    # Escaped braces are valid
    if part == '{{':
        return True, "escaped open brace"
    if part == '}}':
        return True, "escaped close brace"
    # Field pattern: must start with { and end with }
    if part.startswith('{'):
        if part.endswith('}'):
            return True, f"field pattern: {part}"
        else:
            return False, f"starts with {{ but does not end with }}"
    # Text with unmatched braces
    if '{' in part or '}' in part:
        if '{' in part:
            return False, "contains unmatched {"
        else:
            return False, "contains unmatched }"
    # Safe text without braces
    return True, "regular text"

PARSE_RE = re.compile(r"""({{|}}|{\w*(?:(?:\.\w+)|(?:\[[^\]]+\]))*(?::[^}]+)?})""")

tests = [
    ('{abc', 'unclosed brace'),
    ('test}', 'unmatched close'),  
    ('{name}', 'valid named field'),
    ('{{ }}', 'escaped braces'),
    ('{name:w}', 'typed field'),
    ('text {name} more', 'mixed'),
    ('{hello.world}', 'dotted name'),
    ('{data[key]}', 'dict access'),
    ('{{', 'just escaped open'),
    ('}}', 'just escaped close'),
    ('abc{def', 'prefix + unclosed'),
    ('abc}def', 'prefix + unmatched close'),
]

for t, desc in tests:
    parts = PARSE_RE.split(t)
    print(f'Input ({desc}): {t!r}')
    all_ok = True
    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        ok, msg = validate_part(part)
        status = "OK" if ok else "ERROR"
        print(f'  PART[{i}] {status}: {msg}')
        if not ok:
            all_ok = False
    print(f'  Overall: {"OK" if all_ok else "FAIL"}')
    print()
EOF
